news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Negative equity (-₹3.4b). Earnings have declined by 12% per year over the past 5 years. Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (8.7% average weekly change).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹2.48 loss per share (vs ₹2.45 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹2.48 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹2.45 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹84.5m (down 43% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹804.2m (loss widened 1.1% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 4% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 11% per year, which means it is performing significantly worse than earnings.

news.title: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 1.4999645 billion in funding from Shanghvi Finance Pvt Ltd
news.body: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Limited announced a private placement of 38,510,000 Pre-Funded Convertible Warrants at a price per share of INR 38.95 for gross proceeds of INR 1,499,964,500 on January 14, 2026 on preferential basis. Each warrant is convertible into one fully paid-up equity share of the Company having a face value of INR 1 each, within a period of 18 (eighteen) months from the date of allotment of the Warrants, in accordance with applicable law. The transaction involves participation from returning investor Shanghvi Finance Private Limited to purchase 38,510,000 Warrants. The pre-issue equity holding of the investor is 42.28% and post-issue equity holding after exercise of the Warrants will be 48.40% with 175,721,787 equity shares of the company.
